lines.en: I take measured, slow steps.
My hat slipped; I straighten it.
My shoes clack loudly on the tiles.

lines.zh: 我的领结一直系得很正
lines.en: My bow tie stays perfectly straight.
I step down from the main stage.
I hold the microphone in my hand.

lines.zh: 棕色毛毡在灯下有点旧
lines.en: My brown felt looks worn under the lights.
I go around the tables, politely.
My steps keep time like a beat.
A child walks behind me.
I stop and let them pass.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住一整张桌子
lines.en: My shadow covers a whole table.

lines.zh: 走起来，我身上有八音盒的响
lines.en: Walking, a music box ticks inside me.
I patrol the edge of the stage.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直看着前面
lines.en: My eyes stay fixed ahead.
At the door I turn back.

lines.zh: 我站在主舞台上，握着话筒
lines.en: I stand center stage, mic in hand.
I'm quiet. A good signboard.
Light rests on my hat brim.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿一直露在笑里
lines.en: My teeth stay in a smile.
Children gather to photograph me.
I don't blink, and needn't.

lines.zh: 我的衬衫扣子在一颗颗数
lines.en: I count my shirt buttons.

lines.zh: 餐厅里放着我自己的歌
lines.en: The diner plays my own song.
By day I'm only an animatronic.

lines.zh: 等所有人都走了，我才动
lines.en: Only when everyone's gone do I move.

lines.zh: 天花板上的摄像头对着我
lines.en: The ceiling camera faces me.
I bow very slightly.

lines.zh: 我的西装外套有点起球
lines.en: My blazer is pilling.

lines.zh: 地板上有生日蛋糕的碎屑
lines.en: Cake crumbs on the floor.
I move the mic to my left hand.
It's dim behind the stage curtain.
I lift my eyes slowly to you.
Welcome. I host this place.
You stand before my stage.
My smile hasn't changed.
You look like you'll stay past closing.
My eyes are dark beneath the hat.
I tilt my head and wait for you to speak.
I remember where you stood.
The daytime me is polite.
The night me makes no promises.
I raise the mic to my mouth.
But all you'll hear is static.

lines.zh: 我的外套被扯开一道口
lines.en: A tear opens in my blazer.
My hat falls; I pick it up.
Metal shows through the felt.
I sway once, then steady.
No pain, just crooked.
My bow tie has come loose.
The music box inside me goes off key.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一句台词
lines.en: That cut off one of my lines.
The display piece has been damaged.
That's rude, guest.
Cake? I don't eat that.
You hold it up. I look for two seconds.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是为了说话做的
lines.en: My mouth was made for talking.

lines.zh: 这味道盖不住我身上的旧毛
lines.en: That smell can't cover my old felt.
Leave it on the table for someone else.
You crouch. I see clearly.
I have no interest in food.

lines.zh: 你退开三步，我就当没看见
lines.en: Back three steps and I'll pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 这只是个展示品，记得吗
lines.en: Just a display piece, remember?
When the lights go out, try again.
One of my fingers moved.

lines.zh: 别碰我的麦克风，也别碰我。
lines.en: Hands off my microphone, and off me.
I'll remember that cake.
And the way you held it.
Put it away now.
See? I'm polite.
You hit me and I don't budge.
My height gives me the advantage.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，帽檐底下没表情
lines.en: You step back; no expression under my hat.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你的帽子弄掉了
lines.en: That bump knocked your hat off.

lines.zh: 白天我只站着，手扶在展台。
lines.en: By day I stand still, hand on the display.

lines.zh: 我的毛毡很软，里面很硬
lines.en: My felt is soft; what's inside isn't.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音很沉
lines.en: We collide with a deep thud.
Don't touch my bow tie.
I step back and smooth my blazer.
Steady yourself before coming near.

lines.zh: 主舞台上，可以站两个人
lines.en: The main stage holds two.
Let's put on a show together.
You sing; I'll keep time.
You can wear my hat.
Your hands are warmer than mine.
Daytime is short.
When the lights die, I'll still be here.
I won't leave unless you do.

lines.zh: 这句台词我说了很多年
lines.en: I've said this line for many years.
Today I'd like to mean it.
I bend, and my blazer pulls tight.
I nudge it over with my foot.
I set it at the edge of the tray.
Whose is this, dropped here?
I hold it up and look.
If it's useful, I'll keep it.
It fell into the stage gap.
I put it in the lost-and-found.
Useful? Probably not.
These little things are my charge.
I stop waving.

lines.zh: 你留到了不该留的时候
lines.en: You stayed when you shouldn't have.
The music has already stopped.
My smile hasn't changed.
I step half a pace nearer to you.
You back to the door. It's locked.
I host here now.
The lights flicker. See?

lines.zh: 我松开握着话筒的手指
lines.en: I loosen the fingers around my mic.
Then let's begin now.
I follow you slowly.
Every loop brings you back here.
I needn't run; you can't get out.
Only static from the mic.
Your hand is hunting the door handle.
I checked that door already.
I'm very close now.

lines.zh: 你听见我体内的发条声吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the winding gears inside me?
The clock is nearing six.

lines.zh: 白天我站着，夜里才轮到我。
lines.en: By day I stand still; the night is mine.
My hand presses your back.
Tables shift with this charge.
My strength isn't toy-like.
You're shoved into the corner.
My teeth are very close.
The mic goes flying with this swing.
You grab my arm.
My other hand is already there.

lines.zh: 我的关节发出一声长响
lines.en: One joint gives a long creak.
You should have left earlier.

lines.zh: 主舞台的灯亮了，我站在中间
lines.en: Main stage lights up; I'm center.
Welcome to the pizzeria.
Hat, bow tie, mic — all in place.
By day I'm this place's signboard.

lines.zh: 有摄像头正对着这一侧
lines.en: A camera points at this side.
I've stood here many years.
The children see me first.

lines.zh: 我的歌从喇叭里放出来
lines.en: My song plays from the speakers.

lines.zh: 地板上有我踩出的浅坑
lines.en: Shallow dents where I stand.

lines.zh: 我微微鞠躬，向新来的客人
lines.en: I bow slightly to a new guest.
The felt burns with a heavy stink.

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下，帽子滚远了
lines.en: I fall off stage and my hat rolls away.
Water fills my shell; the song stops.

lines.zh: 气浪把我连同桌子一起掀翻
lines.en: The blast flips me and the table.
An arrow sinks deep in my chest.

lines.zh: 这光让我的八音盒乱转
lines.en: That light sends my music box spinning.
Power's low. My motions slow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，帽子都焦了
lines.en: Lightning hits me and singes my hat.
The stage is gone and I'm falling.
